input.overview: Al's Garage Band has several independently qualified features. Complete Delmore, Stitchy, and Dr. Skins to light Gig Lock; lock two balls, then shoot the CD or Video ramp to start Multiball. The looping road shot visits cities toward World Tour, while ramp shots spell ROCK & ROLL for timed 2x and 3x playfield scoring.
input.simpleOverview: Complete Delmore, Stitchy, and Dr. Skins to light Gig Lock. Lock two balls, then shoot the CD or Video ramp for Multiball. Loops visit cities, and ramps spell ROCK & ROLL for timed 2x and 3x scoring.
input.summary: Build the three band-member targets into a two-lock Multiball start, while taking safe loops for cities and ramps for the separate ROCK & ROLL scoring ladder.

steps.text: Complete the Delmore, Stitchy, and Dr. Skins target groups to light Gig Lock.
After the second lock, shoot the CD or Video ramp to start Multiball.
During Multiball, shoot the CD ramp for Jackpot while using ramps to advance ROCK & ROLL.

alternatives.title: World Tour and scoring-multiplier work
alternatives.when: Use this while lock targets are unsafe or between clean Multiball opportunities.

steps.text: Repeat the loop to collect city lamps toward World Tour.
Shoot ramps to spell ROCK & ROLL and start timed 2x, then 3x playfield scoring.
Complete M-I-X to advance its multiplier and light Video Mode.
Complete all three band-member target groups.
Lock two balls at the lit Gig Lock.
Shoot the CD or Video ramp to start Multiball, then return to the CD ramp for Jackpot.

machineSetup: Test all three band-member target groups, Gig Lock and release, CD and Video ramps, city loop, ROCK & ROLL lamps, M-I-X switches, guitar awards, and Feedback kickback.
Confirm Feature Adjustment 05 for lock difficulty, M-I-X and Extra Ball recall, Feedback difficulty, tournament mode, and Special conversion.

playfieldReferences.label: Gig ball lock
playfieldReferences.description: Lock lit by the three band-member target groups.

playfieldReferences.label: CD ramp
playfieldReferences.description: Ramp that can start Multiball after two locks and scores Jackpot during it.

playfieldReferences.label: Video ramp
playfieldReferences.description: Alternate Multiball start ramp after two balls are locked.

playfieldReferences.label: World Tour loop
playfieldReferences.description: Loop that awards cities toward World Tour.

cautions.issue: Gig Lock qualification changes with the operator's Easy, Medium, or Hard setting.
cautions.response: On Medium, complete Delmore, Stitchy, and Dr. Skins; Easy can let a ramp spot one group, while Hard requires two completions.
